questions.q: What does "fscmRestApi" stand for in an Oracle Fusion REST URL?
options: Financials and Supply Chain Management REST API
questions.explain: fscmRestApi is the shared REST root for Financials and Supply Chain Management.

questions.q: Which resource would you call to retrieve Accounts Payable invoice data?
questions.explain: The invoices resource covers AP invoice headers and lines.

questions.q: Which resource covers General Ledger journal entries?
questions.explain: journals is the GL journal entries resource.

questions.q: What is a risk of using "latest" instead of a fixed version string in a URL for a production integration?
options: latest is always slower to respond
A Fusion update could change the resource's shape underneath the integration without warning
latest cannot be used with GET requests
There is no risk; latest and a fixed version always behave identically
questions.explain: latest always resolves to the newest version, so behavior can shift when Oracle updates the environment.

questions.q: In the URL https://myco.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com/fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/invoices, what does 11.13.18.05 represent?
options: The REST API version being called
questions.explain: That segment is the REST API version string.
